column1: # Curated symbol table for the MStar MST9U (AEON) scaler AP.
# Our own annotations (not vendor symbols) — edit freely and re-run regen.sh.
# Addresses are RAM, image = COMBINED (ap_prefix.bin + ap_decompressed.bin) at
# 0x180000 (i.e. the inflated stream sits at 0x183800). Applied after the auto
# namer so these override it. Confidence: [C]=confirmed [I]=inferred [?]=tentative.
# RESET 2026-10-11: emptied after the load-base fix (prior entries were 0x3800
# low). Rebuild from fresh regen.sh dumps / the auto tsv. A few base-fixed
# anchors below, re-derived on the correct base:

column4: [C] glyph renderer (was 0x219504 pre-fix, +0x3800)

[?] (reg,val,mask) register write; e.g. (0x101d20,0,1)
[C] win_enable_frame_color(i,0) for window 0, or all four when g_sys_ctx+0x45c!=0: windows show their 3-3-2 colour (0xff) instead of video

[C] references "TCON_Format%d"; timing-controller setup
[C] debug print (no-op unless g_dbg_enable set); takes a string arg
[C] byte write to a scaler register: *(g_scaler_mmio_base + enc(reg)) = val

[C] Osd_Hide: OSD window 1 off (0x101d20 bit0); window 3 off unless g_osd_mode is 4/0x0b. Name is historical; not a scaler setup
[C] OSD window 2 off (0x101d40 bit0). Name is historical
[?] scaler register setup
[?] larger scaler/panel setup (many sub-calls)
[C] base pointer for scaler MMIO register writes
[C] debug-print enable flag (gates dbg_print)
[I] input/detect status flags (bits 8, 0x2000, 0x4000, 0x8000)

column4: [C] wrapper (win_group, colour332): wait FUN_ram_001d11b0 then tail-jump to win_set_nosig_color_332. 3-3-2 = bits5-7 R, 2-4 G, 0-1 B: 0x03 blue 0xe0 red 0x1c green 0xff white 0x00 black
[C] set_frame_color(R,G,B) -> frame-colour reg 0x90102f33 only. Caller FUN_ram_002027b0 passes white = the surround of the searching/splash logo. PATCHED (feature a): 0x1c7119 forces black
[C] BURN-IN colour cycle (g_osd_mode==0x0d, separate demo mode; NOT the stable no-signal screen) through g_nosig_bg_colors
[C] 8 packed-3-3-2 colours for the burn-in cycle: [0]black [1]blue [2]purple [3]red [4]green [5]blue [6]cyan [7]magenta
[C] write 24-bit value (RGB) to reg,reg+1,reg+2
[C] byte write to a scaler register (base g_scaler_mmio_base)

column1: # Spot-checked: read-byte mirror enc, bus-lock refcount (546x), Switch Source.
#    Register addr encoding: phys byte offset = (reg&0xffffff)*2 - (reg&1),
#    added to g_scaler_mmio_base; a set top bit selects a bank page.

column4: [?] returns *(reg|0x80000000); direct high-bit (uncached) byte read, no base/bank translation
[I] byte read at enc(reg)+base WITHOUT the high-bit bank select; read counterpart of 0x1c60d7
[I] byte write at enc(reg)+base WITHOUT bank select; write counterpart of 0x1c60b2 (cf. scaler_mmio_write_byte 0x1c6162 which adds bank)
[C] read counterpart of scaler_mmio_write_byte: same enc + high-bit bank page write; used by every read/RMW below
[I] locked read-modify-write: SET masked bits if param2!=0 else CLEAR them; brackets access with g_scaler_bus_lock_count + HW lock reg base+0x203034
[C] 16-bit read: (reg+1)<<8 | reg via scaler_mmio_read_byte
[C] 16-bit write: reg=lo byte, reg+1=hi byte via scaler_mmio_write_byte
[C] per-window double-buffer enable/latch: RMW bank-0 byte 0x84 (ctx-0x7fffff7c) bits 0/2 for each window in mask. Brackets colour writes; not a display gate
[C] 16-bit masked RMW (reg,val,mask): scaler_reg_write(reg,..) + scaler_reg_write(reg+1,..)
[C] 24-bit read reg,reg+1,reg+2 (read counterpart of scaler_reg_write24)
[C] 24-bit masked RMW (reg,val,mask); low two bytes via scaler_reg_write, top byte locked-RMW inline
[C] refcount guarding the scaler register bus; inc/dec around every locked RMW, paired with HW lock reg at g_scaler_mmio_base+0x203034 (appears in ~all RMW primitives)

column1: # 2. Scaler per-channel output enable / coefficient writers
#    Channel register base 0x101d00 + ch*0x20 (ch0=0x101d00, ch1=0x101d20, ch2=0x101d40)

column4: [C] OSD WINDOW on/off (MStar drvOSD_SetWndOn): bit0 of 0x101d00 + win*0x20. Name is historical; these are OSD windows, not scaler channels
[C] OSD window ctrl write (drvOSD_SetWndCtrl): (win, ctrl 0..3 -> +0x00/02/14/1a, value, mask). Name is historical

column1: # 3. OSD / screen state machine + input handling (around osd_no_input_handler 0x1e73fe)

column4: [C] OSD window 2 on/off by g_osd_mode: modes 0x11..0x5f except 'J' -> off, else on. Name is historical

[I] OSD state-transition step: takes an event code (0x24/0x36/0x3e seen); forces g_osd_mode='B' per g_osd_substate; returns 1 when screen inactive (g_osd_mode high bit set). Tail-twin of osd_no_input_handler
[?] OSD/menu event filter: takes event/key code, branches on g_osd_mode and ctx flag byte (g_sys_ctx+0x44b), drives submenu index bRam00307bf2
[C] "Load prop font"; renders osd_master_table[g_osd_mode] entry for current language (g_sys_ctx+0x47b) via osd_render_glyph_string; modes>=0x70 use osd_master_table_hi
[I] low-level helper: pick the per-language entry (index g_sys_ctx+0x47b) from a string table arg and render it
[I] initialises the g_sys_ctx struct with factory defaults (0x80/0x80/0x80, 0xff.., 0x32.. look like picture-quality defaults)

[I] pointer to the main AP context/settings struct. OSD SM fields: +0x44b flags(bit0 power-on,0x8/0x20 used,0x80), +0x452 current source id, +0x45d current-port index, +0x45e per-port->scaler map array, +0x47b OSD language idx, +0xc7a current timing index (table stride 0xcc)
[I] secondary screen-id -> per-language string table, used when g_osd_mode>=0x70 (companion to osd_master_table)

column1: # 4. Input / source detection, status monitor, timing & panel power

column4: [I] status-monitor pump: walks per-port/scaler/window state tables (g_scaler_state_tbl) and logs transitions ("[SMInput]/[SMScaler]/[SMWindow]", "FPLL_T Lock/No Lock"). (auto-named FPLL_T = just one substring)
[C] per-scaler valid-timing change detector: "Valid Timing : Sync Loss" + Vtotal/Hstart/HPeriod/polarity/VDE/HDE changed; returns 1 on any change
[C] "PrepareForTimingChange SrcInputPort=%d"; resets timers, mutes scaler reg 0x406, dispatches OSD event 0x3e when g_osd_mode=='-'
[I] " PrepareForTimingChange:%d"; per-port entry invoked from sm_poll_input_scaler_window
[C] analog VGA/SOG input-port enable/disable path ("InputPort_____VGA" / "InputPort_____SOG"); (port, enable)
[C] "@@@@@ Switch Source to %d"; writes new source id to g_sys_ctx+0x452
[C] "Zonic APPSystem_CheckPowerStatus"; DC/AC ON, DC OFF, DPMS?? ON; drives g_input_status bit 0x8 (standby/power) and g_sys_ctx+0x44b bit0 (power-on)
[C] "Power_TurnOffPanel"; backlight/panel-off sequence (uses timing table at g_sys_ctx + idx*0xcc)
[C] "Power_TurnOnPanel"; panel power-on sequence
[I] busy/timer delay; called throughout power/source paths with ms-looking args (200,300,500,0x50)

column1: # ---- status tables referenced by the state machine (data) ----

column4: [I] per-scaler/window state records, stride 0x4c. Fields: +0x4 timing byte, +0x6 mode word, +0x8 settle timer, +0x10 flags(0x1=active/dirty), +0x14 sync/timing status (0x3 polarity bits, 0xc sync-loss)
[I] per-port previous-status shadow bytes (indexed 1..3), compared against live status in sm_poll_input_scaler_window to detect edges

column1: # The no-signal logo is OSD TEXT: mono font glyphs + a palette colour attribute.
# A 248-entry palette exists at 0x2d2dc8 (earlier "no CLUT" note was wrong).

column4: [C] mode-4 LoadFont callback (menu page table 0x2d9200 +0x14): loads the logo glyphs at font index 0x20 and the ? icon at 0xcf. Draws nothing. Name is historical
[C] compressed MONO font loader (MStar LoadCompressedFont): (font index, data, count) via OSD RAM port 0x101c66/67/68; 16-bit words, top nibble=repeat, low 12 bits=data. Name is historical
[C] 2-bit colour font loader (two bitplanes -> font RAM). Used for colour icons, not for the no-signal logo
[C] "Load prop font": renders osd_master_table[g_osd_mode] for current language via osd_render_glyph_string
[C] compressed mono FONT data for the no-signal Dell logo glyphs (loaded at font index 0x20). NOT the JPEG
[C] compressed mono font data for the ? icon glyphs (font index 0xcf)
[C] MStar MENU PAGE TABLE, stride 0x1c, indexed by g_osd_mode: +0 XSize +1 YSize +4 prev page +8 items(0x2c each) +0xc item count +0x10 Exec fn +0x14 LoadFont fn +0x18 flags. mode4 @0x2d9270

column1: # 5. Display-window colour/video gate + OSD internals (feature a, 2026-10-12)
#    [C] here = confirmed from code AND by hardware result (builds v10/v11).

column4: [C] (mask, v): per window in mask, bank 0x10 byte 0x32 bit (0x20 even / 0x02 odd): v=1 show VIDEO, v=0 show the window's 3-3-2 no-signal colour. PATCHED: entry hooked -> cave 0x182048 forces v=0 while g_osd_mode is 4/0x0b

[C] the one real colour setter (win_group, colour332): writes per-window 3-3-2 bytes (bank 0x0f byte 0x2f even / bank 0x10 byte 0x48 odd) AND frame colour 0x90102f33 expanded from it. PATCHED: 0x1c7004 hooked -> cave 0x182063 forces colour 0x00
[C] "[msScalerAP] Enable Frame Color" (win, v): win_set_show_video(mask, v); if v==0 then win_set_nosig_color_332(win, 0xff)
[I] (win, v): v=1 -> per-scaler setup then win_set_show_video(mask,1); v=0 -> arm the countdown byte at 0x30f724+win*0x84. Called from sm_poll_input_scaler_window
[C] (1,R,G,B): save+clear display-window enable bits (bank 0x20 byte 0x20 bits0/1), write frame colour -> full-screen solid colour; (0,..) restores. Saved colour in 0x2cf710
[C] 256-step grey ramp via frame_color_fullscreen, then restore. No static caller
[I] menu page 7 Exec: osd_set_frame_color_rgb(white), draw the JPEG logo (FUN_ram_00202710 -> FUN_ram_001efda8), Osd_Hide, panel on, Osd_Show. Source of the searching-screen white surround
[C] decodes the Dell logo JPEG (TEL id 0xc500) into frame memory for a display window ("Get JPG BINFO", "Decompress OK")
[C] MStar DrawOsdMenu: per-g_osd_mode window size/position/colours, calls the page LoadFont fn, draws items
[C] Osd_Show: OSD window 1 on; for menu modes also windows 2 and 3 off
[C] OSD init: global OSD regs, windows 1..3 ctrl/alpha/text base, palette, base fonts
[C] loads the 248-entry OSD palette from osd_palette via port select 0xa/0xd, then colour-key flags via 0xc
[C] (win, level 0/1/2, value): +0x0d/+0x19/+0x0c of the window block, low 6 bits
[C] (win, addr): text-RAM base at +0x10/11
[C] (win, R, G, B): window fixed colour at +0x16/17/18. Only static caller passes window 0, black

[C] the 6 menu items (0x2c each) of page 4. Item 0/1 show the logo icons
